info.title: MedMap API
info.description: REST API for MedMap. MedMap is an information tool, not medical advice. Errors use application/problem+json (RFC 7807).

post.summary: Create an account and start a session
Rotate the refresh cookie and get a new access token

Confirm an email address with the emailed token
Ask for a password reset link
Set a new password with the emailed token
